If everyone can build software, who is going to buy your application?

"Bro, I've built an application. How do I market it? How do I get customers? How do I actually sell it?"

That's exactly what we're discussing in this video.

Building software is becoming easier. Getting customers is still the real challenge!

AI Is Changing the SaaS Industry

With AI powered coding tools, developers and entrepreneurs can create applications more quickly.

But faster development also means more products competing for attention.

That's why understanding your customers, identifying real problems, and building an effective distribution strategy are essential.

The question is no longer just "Can you build it?"

The bigger question is "Can you find customers who need it?"

On November 21, 2019, Elon Musk launched the Cybertruck, and the market went crazy!!
In just under 2 day, they got 146,000 reservations, 250,000 reservations in five days and by October 2023 they had 1 Million reservations!!
and if these orders were fulfilled, Tesla would have made about $75 Billion dollars in revenue.
So on paper, the Cybertruck alone was worth more than Nike, Coca-Cola or Starbucks each bring in from an entire year of sales!!
No pickup truck in history had ever been this famous before it was even built but even then, Today, Tesla is shutting down the production of Cybertruck!
And do you realise, it makes no sense!!
Tesla has all the money and trust in the world, it has Elon musk as its ambassador, they had a million reservations and a $75 billion order book behind it. On paper, it had everything a product could possibly need to win.
So then the question is,
Why did Tesla shut down Cybertruck?

videos.title: HILARY DUFF: The Family Truth Behind Lizzie McGuire's Smile
videos.description:
Hilary Duff on the family truth she spent years tiptoeing around.

In this episode, Hilary Duff and Jay Shetty talk about the songs on her first album in over a decade, and the real life behind them. She explains why, as painful as it is to share, she could only write about what she has lived through.

She looks back at growing up in the public eye from the age of 10: the comments on her body as a teenager, the innocence she says she lost by 15, and the mom who kept her grounded. She opens up about divorce, co-parenting, and why a kind partner was so hard to accept.

And she talks about being the peacemaker when her parents split up, the father she wishes would show up, and why some of the hardest relationships are in your own family.

Learn why she calls it a raw nerve. And learn what she still hopes for the person she grew up with.

videos.title: Why Walking Away Is So Hard (And How to Know When It's Time)
videos.description:
Most of us already know when something isn't working. The hard part is not starting over. It's letting go.

In this episode, Jay Shetty talks about why we hold on to relationships, jobs and dreams we have already outgrown. He explains the bias that makes a loss feel about twice as strong as an equal gain, and the trap that keeps us paying for years we have already spent.

He shares the one question that removes nostalgia from a hard decision, and why what we really hold on to is often the person we got to be inside a situation, not the situation itself.

And he talks about the hidden cost of staying, what research on regret says we regret most over time, and why a feeling is not an instruction.

Learn why your brain protects a life you no longer want. And learn the question to ask before you stay in anything.
